statement.p: Find two numbers differing by 32 whose product is as small as possible.
Enter your two numbers as a comma separated list, e.g. 2, 3.

solution.p: We are trying to find two numbers x and y such that their product P=xy is at a minimum, and we are also given that x-y=32. Solve for one of the variables, say x= 32+y. Substitute back into the product equation to get P= (32+y)y=32 y +y^2 Since we're trying to find a minimum, take the derivative and set it equal to 0. P'= 32+ 2y =0 Thus y=\frac{-32}{2}=-16.
We already said above that x= 32+y, so x=32+( -16)=16.
